explication: OmnySSH is a multi-frontend SSH server manager: a desktop GUI and maintained terminal UI use a shared Rust core. Users manage hosts, inspect server health, open SSH terminals, transfer files, run snippets, and configure keys and tunnels. The README documents additional search, streamer mode, themes, and updates. The graph reflects those documented capabilities; several backend links use enclosing source directories because their implementation was not sampled.
